kk-engine BUG-087: a GCC 16 Release build (-O3, KKE_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON) of the fetched third-party code warns twice in opus (silk/decode_indices.c, -Wstringop-overflow: GCC cannot see that psDec->nb_subfr is at most MAX_NB_SUBFR, the size of GainsIndices and LTPIndex) and once in sqlite (sqlite3ColumnSetColl, -Wstringop-overread: GCC assumes pCol->zCnName may be NULL and then reads zCnName+n). The project fixes such warnings at the cause by patching the fetched source with an idempotent CMake script run as FetchContent's PATCH_COMMAND, like cmake/patch_rmlui.cmake (given). Docs only: the BUG-087 row says the last two warnings are fixed. Your SEARCH block is exactly these lines:

CI's GCC 13 and RelWithDebInfo (-O2) don't see either. | Fixed 2026-10-04: `VoronoiFracture.cpp` keeps the chunk list sorted as it inserts (no `std::sort`), the test sizes its vector once. Found by `tools/runner/kkrun build --type Release` on soucouyant |
